samples.description: Fractional CFO or wealth advisor referring deals ad-hoc

answers.q1_currentHandling: I refer capital opportunities elsewhere today
answers.q5_pursuingDecision: Gut feel after talking to the borrower
answers.q6_documentHandling: We do not collect documents — our partner handles that
answers.q7_routingDecision: I send to the 1-2 lenders or brokers I know best
answers.q8_followUpAutomation: Almost nothing — every email, text, and call is manual
q9_breakdownPoints: Losing track of where deals stand in the pipeline
Borrowers going dark after getting an offer
Knowing which lender will actually approve the deal
q10_priorities: Keep full visibility of every active deal
Turn capital into revenue without becoming a full-time broker
answers.q12_handsOnControl: Hybrid — I want to qualify and advise, with an infrastructure partner packaging and placing

samples.description: Active commercial broker or debt advisor with a high-volume team

answers.q1_currentHandling: My team handles an active funding pipeline
answers.q6_documentHandling: Dedicated document collection portal with checklists
answers.q7_routingDecision: We use a structured lender matrix with defined criteria
answers.q8_followUpAutomation: Automated document reminders and pipeline notifications
q9_breakdownPoints: Manual data entry and packaging credit memos
q10_priorities: Package deals faster with less effort
Route to the right lender on the first attempt
answers.q12_handsOnControl: Full operator — I want to build and run an end-to-end capital desk
